subject.title: [Bug]: macOS: gateway bind=loopback resolves to 0.0.0.0 and refuses to start (2026.4.11, 1006 on health)

question: For https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81306, should maintainers require live patched Gateway proof before merge, or accept source-level resolver proof for this pure bind-resolution branch?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and the linked PR is narrow, but the external PR's proof is source/test output rather than a live macOS Gateway run; only a maintainer should override that proof gate.

options.title: Require patched Gateway proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require redacted startup/status logs or terminal output from a real patched Gateway run before merging the linked PR.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate for the linked PR if the resolver branch and regression test are sufficient.

options.title: Replace the PR
options.body: If the branch cannot reach the proof bar soon, open or adopt a narrow maintainer-owned replacement with equivalent resolver and test coverage.

recommendation.title: Require patched Gateway proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require redacted startup/status logs or terminal output from a real patched Gateway run before merging the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest history on the runtime guard and adjacent Gateway bind safety decisions.
